scope: Independent descriptive analysis of ONLY completed conditional-boundaries v2 raw rank JSON. No use of another analyzer output as numeric input. No remote/model/kernel/test/update calls. Current production unchanged. No new tolerance or causal percentage.

definition.C_i: Original full-span joint finite coefficient at boundary i contracted via original CPU FP64 _token_effect against actual matched-layout singleEOS factual-minus-deleted BF16 suffix activations.
definition.native_difference: Original FP32 categorical target log probability factual minus singleEOS, within the same paired native root.
definition.boundary32: final norm input, before final norm and categorical head; not head output.
definition.unique_aggregation: Arithmetic mean across repeated original transport slots for the SAME UID, source step, source position and token ID; duplicates also preserved individually.
definition.layer_delta: C_i-C_(i+1); describes contraction change through the measured decoder boundary. It does not identify numerical error versus joint-endpoint decomposition by itself.

limitations: These are 42 fixed random source-token probes from 21 successful first responses at checkpoint25, not population-wide quality estimates.
Both raw ranks include shared original transport identities; 52 rows are not independent samples.
A boundary contraction residual alone cannot distinguish BF16 storage effects, finite approximation, or joint-vs-single endpoint effects; no official FA/FLA kernel defect is inferred.
The existing failed v1 root-only run is excluded.
No whole-network tolerance, rescaling, normalization, entropy adjustment, method change, training update or production deployment is introduced.

Native singleEOS log-probability differences are actual effects inside the current Qwen categorical readout; this analysis does not establish corresponding real-world reward interventions or exact world-token values.
